purpose: Fresh source baseline for a controlled comparison with the current candidate on the same host.
sourceMethod: Git archive of tracked files into a new isolated private directory; no reset, checkout, index change or modification of the current source tree.

dependencies.resolution: Existing ancestor node_modules reused because the package and lockfile blobs exactly match.

build.fingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(sorted [POSIX-relative-path, file-SHA256] pairs), matching scripts/check-static.mjs.
build.reproducibilityBoundary: This is a fresh build of the identified Git source and lockfile at a different build path. Generated chunk identifiers and HTML hashes can differ with that build context. Source identity is verified; bit-for-bit identity with a historical build is not claimed.

preparationOnly: These hashes and HTTP checks identify build inputs and served artifacts. No browser or performance result is inferred from this preparation record.
